commit.message:
Move TImmortal to library/cpp/yt/misc and adopt it more widely

Move TImmortal from memory to misc so that library/cpp/yt/system, which memory depends on, can use it.

Switch to TImmortal:
* undumpable: UndumpableMemoryManager was constinit but still destroyed at exit; unmarking from a later static destructor touched a destroyed hash map.
* YT_LOG_* anchors: constinit instead of TLeakyStorage, dropping the static-init guard check at every log site.
* Global tracer storage: constinit global per the old TODO.
* GetThreadMessageTags fallback, InternHostName host set, TAtForkManager (hand-rolled buffer).
